items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ray was 14 when I met them. Tom was 15.

ctx.x: Let’s go back to Philadelphia, because all the families – you’ve got the Heath family. You’ve got Jimmy, Percy. You got Tootie. Then you got the Barrons. I’m talking about the Barrons. But you also mentioned Ray Bryant. What about Tommy?

Tom Bryant. Yeah, he was the same. I think they were – Ray was 14 when I met them. Tom was 15. These guys, they were exceptional. That’s all I can say. They were exceptional. So as a result, they played with the grownups, I guess you would call them – guys 35, 40 years old. We called them the old men. They were in junior high school. So as a result, their father used to have to take them to the job in that 1937 Chevy and pick them up and bring them back. They would play with us too, but they were playing with…
